proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 916 article gives Malayalam ēṟuka to rise, increase, be much, arise, ascend; ēṟa much, more, beyond; ēṟṟuka to raise, embark, multiply; ēṟṟam rising, ascent, increase, climbing, pulling up, what is too much, embarkation; ēṟṟu mounting palm trees, flow of tide; ēlkka (ēṟṟ-) to….
